d:
Kartik purnima ke pavan avsar par sunen hanuman ji, bhagvan vishnu evan shri satyanarayan svami ki bhakti se saje is vishesh bhajan sangrah ko.
Mangalvar ke shubh din aur kartik purnima ke pavitr sanyog par prastut hai yah bhaktimay bhajan sangrah, jismen sankatmochan hanuman ashtak, hanuman amritvani, shri satyanarayan dhun aur bhagvan vishnu ke madhur bhajnon ka sundar sangam hai.
Bhagvan hanuman ji ki kripa, shri hari vishnu ka aashirvad aur satyanarayan svami ki bhakti aapke jivan men sukh, shanti aur mangal lekar aae.
jay shri hanuman!
Om namo bhagavte vasudevay!
jay lakshmi narayan!
